cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, contemplative mood established by a single voice and sparse vocal percussion, evoking a sense of isolation in nature.
cards.palette: The human voice serves as the sole instrument.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Deep within the shadow of the pines,
Where the silver moss softly entwines,
A single breath meets the morning air,
Finding peace in a world so bare.
[Pre-Chorus]
Roots reach deep into the ground,
Where the ancient secrets are found.
[Chorus]
Carry the light through the heavy wood,
Understanding life as it is understood,
Hand in hand by the hearth fire’s glow,
Where the steady rivers of spirit flow.
[Verse]
Each falling leaf tells a story old,
In colors of copper and burning gold,
The mountain stands tall in a crown of gray,
Watching the seasons turn day by day.
[Pre-Chorus]
Listen to the wind begin to sigh,
Under the arch of a vast, open sky.
[Chorus]
Carry the light through the heavy wood,
Understanding life as it is understood,
Hand in hand by the hearth fire’s glow,
Where the steady rivers of spirit flow.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The heavy stones are laid in line,
Binding the earth and the soul divine.
[Chorus]
Carry the light through the heavy wood,
Understanding life as it is understood,
Hand in hand by the hearth fire’s glow,
Where the steady rivers of spirit flow.
[Outro]
